text:
Maria: p99 spiked right after the runtime deploy. Long prompts + tool calls seem worst. anyone else seeing this?
Aj: yep, noticed p99 from ~1.2s -> ~3.8s in us-west1 canary. p95 mostly ok. :frowning: 
Kevin: can you post a profile? kernel / microbatch / kv stats please.
Maria: posting quick snapshot from canary profiler:```profile snapshot
model: vicuna-13b-q4
kernel: fused-attn-v2
microbatch: 8
p95: 240ms
p99: 3.8s
kv_cache_hit_rate: 32%
kv_cache_miss_seq_pct: 68%
gpu_util: 78%
notes: tool-call sequences show many small increments to context leading to cache churn
```
Liu: interesting — high KV miss for tool sequences screams eviction. Are we rekeying cache on every tool result append?
Aj: yes, tool calls append full tool output into the prompt, so cache key changes. plus we changed microbatch default to 8 in last deploy to favor throughput. might be interacting badly.
Kevin: microbatch=8 increases batching latency window; for low-latency tails it can worsen p99 when KV misses trigger fallback kernels.
Maria: ran two short A/Bs: microbatch=4 vs 8 on canary. microbatch=4 -> p99 long-prompt down to ~920ms but overall throughput -18%. microbatch=12 -> p95 slightly better but p99 jumped further.
Aj: thanks. so tradeoff confirmed: smaller microbatch improves tail but costs throughput. we need smarter heuristic: dynamic microbatching by estimated prompt length / tool-call count.
Liu: also kernel selection: fused-attn-v2 is great for steady-state, but when KV miss causes long reattends it falls back to attention-slowpath which is much slower for long context. maybe tune kernel chooser to prefer stable cache-friendly kernels when tool-call pattern detected.
Kevin: what about a KV policy change — prefix-only cache keys so appended tool outputs don't invalidate earlier prefixes? could reduce misses on chaining tool calls.
Maria: tried a quick prefix-only KV sim locally: KV hit rate -> 74%, p99 -> 880ms (microbatch=8). throughput ~+2%. promising. caveat: must ensure correctness for cases where tool output alters model state in ways that must be re-evaluated.
Aj: we can add a safety mode: prefix-only for pure-generation routes, full-key for stateful tool routes. routing config per endpoint.
infra-bot: deploy-log: canary 7f3b rolled back to microbatch=4 at 1965001450 (auto action).
Kevin: next steps: 1) run a 6-hour canary with prefix-only KV on tool-call-heavy routes and microbatch=8 2) add heuristics: if tool-call-count > 1 then microbatch=4 or dynamic window 3) adjust kernel chooser to prefer slowpath-resistant kernel for long prompt sequences.
Maria: will open tickets for 1 + 2. Liu will prototype kernel chooser change. Aj will coordinate canary config.
Liu: I'll instrument a per-request annotation that flags "tool-chain" so we can A/B the cache policy safely.
Aj: sounds good. schedule: start canary tonight 22:00 UTC, collect 6h metrics, then sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks all. I'll drop the profiling traces into the ticket.
